host.name: Meera
host.bio: Meera hosts every lesson in both tracks. She says each phrase the way a native speaker would, then explains what it means and when to use it.

challenge.title: 60-Day Language Challenge
challenge.blurb: One lesson a day. 10 languages, 6 lessons each, 60 days. Finish every section to earn your certificate.

categories.name: Local languages
categories.blurb: Five major Indian languages, spoken by more than 400 million people across the East and South of India.

categories.name: International languages
categories.blurb: Five of the world's most useful languages for study abroad, travel, business and careers.

lessons.title: Greetings & courtesy
lessons.goal: Say hello, ask how someone is, thank them and say goodbye.

lessons.title: Introducing yourself
lessons.goal: Tell people your name and where you are from, and ask about them.

phrases.en: I speak a little of your language.

lessons.title: Numbers & time
lessons.goal: Count from one to ten and talk about today and tomorrow.

lessons.title: Food & shopping
lessons.goal: Order food, ask prices and pay the bill.

lessons.title: Travel & directions
lessons.goal: Ask the way, understand left, right and straight, and ask for help.

lessons.title: Everyday conversation
lessons.goal: Keep a conversation going: yes, no, I don't understand, please repeat.
